heading: People
body: Our group studies how energy, nutrients, and contaminants connect ecosystems. We combine field and laboratory work, ecological tracers, and quantitative modeling to understand food webs and environmental change.
join_text: Interested in joining our research group as an undergraduate, graduate student, or postdoctoral researcher?

items.name: Sydney Moyo
items.bio: I am an aquatic ecologist studying how energy, nutrients, and contaminants move across aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems. My research combines field studies, stable isotopes, fatty-acid biomarkers, and ecological modeling.

items.name: Kaydence Dubroc
items.bio: Kaydence's research examines how stable isotopes and fatty-acid biomarkers can be used to study freshwater mussel ecology.

items.name: Sarah Kerr
items.role: Ph.D. Student | Mercury Contaminant Transfer & Science Communication
items.bio: Sarah's research examines the transfer of mercury from aquatic to terrestrial ecosystems, with a focus on mercury accumulation in arachnids. She is also interested in scientific communication and making ecological research accessible to broader audiences.

items.name: MiKia Alexander
items.bio: MiKia's research examines mercury bioaccumulation in spiders and dragonflies.

items.name: Lenin Chari
items.bio: Lenin worked on aquatic–terrestrial linkages in Louisiana streams.

items.name: Cadence Gilbert
items.bio: Cadence was our resident fatty-acid extraction extraordinaire! She contributes to ongoing research by preparing and extracting biological samples for fatty-acid analysis, bringing remarkable speed and efficiency to laboratory work.

items.name: Ava Benfiglio
items.bio: Ava contributed to laboratory research involving stable isotope analysis, supporting our work on food webs and resource use across ecosystems.

items.name: Eduardo Howell
items.bio: Eduardo was part of our fatty-acid team! He contributed to laboratory research by preparing biological samples and conducting fatty-acid extractions, helping us investigate food webs and resource use across ecosystems.
